intro.text: The sea between Opelon and the northern continent where Teod lies. Sailing across it from Teod to Kae takes about five days.

description.text: Small islands are scattered across it between Arelon and Teod and near Svorden. Long stretches of the Arelene, Svordish and Fjordell coasts face the sea.

The sea serves both travel and trade, and Teoras and Widor are among its ports. Its salty waters smell of brine and sea life, and trike, a fish eaten as food, is abundant. Merchant fleets, among them those of King Iadon and Duke Telrii, sail it in spite of raids by pirates.

items.text: Teod was long regarded as having the strongest armada in the region, but the Fjordell Empire's fleets grew much stronger once it annexed Svorden and took over the Svordish navy.
